name: multisig
description: The on-chain multisig governance plugin in which a proposal passes if X out of Y approvals are met.
change:
v1.3
 - Removed an unnecessary permission that allowed the DAO to upgrade the plugin, because this is supposed to happen as part of the update itself. The unnecessary permission, which was granted on installation of previous versions, is automatically removed with the update to this version.
